mapper.select: SELECT s.slot_date AS slotDate, s.start_time AS startTime, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bookings b JOIN time_slots s ON b.slot_id = s.id WHERE b.shop_id = #{shopId} AND b.status IN ('CONFIRMED','CHECKED_IN','NO_SHOW') AND s.slot_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY s.slot_date, s.start_time
SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM escalations WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY reason ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT b.id, b.booking_no AS bookingNo, b.status, b.customer_name AS customerName, b.customer_phone AS customerPhone, b.party_size AS partySize, b.remark, b.source, b.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, b.hold_expire_at AS holdExpireAt, b.created_at AS createdAt, b.checked_in_at AS checkedInAt, b.customer_session_id AS customerSessionId, s.slot_date AS slotDate, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, si.name AS serviceName FROM bookings b JOIN time_slots s ON b.slot_id = s.id JOIN service_items si ON b.service_item_id = si.id WHERE s.slot_date = #{date} AND b.shop_id = #{shopId} ORDER BY s.start_time ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(s.slot_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS total, IFNULL(SUM(b.party_size), 0) AS people FROM bookings b JOIN time_slots s ON b.slot_id = s.id WHERE b.shop_id = #{shopId} AND s.slot_date > #{from} AND s.slot_date <= #{to} AND b.status IN ('HELD','CONFIRMED') GROUP BY s.slot_date ORDER BY s.slot_date ASC

SELECT b.booking_no AS bookingNo, b.status, s.slot_date AS slotDate, s.start_time AS startTime, si.name AS serviceName, b.party_size AS partySize, b.customer_name AS customerName, b.customer_phone AS customerPhone, b.remark, b.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, b.created_at AS createdAt FROM bookings b JOIN time_slots s ON b.slot_id = s.id JOIN service_items si ON b.service_item_id = si.id WHERE b.shop_id = #{shopId} AND s.slot_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY s.slot_date ASC, s.start_time ASC
